10442732.en: I'll remember your words. I will keep watching if your sect truly is as you've described.

10442734.en: Oh, be honest now—you lured me here just to get me to help you with cultivation, didn't you? Very good. I like ambitious people. Let's begin.

10442735.en: As long as it's from you, I'll love it.

10442736.en: My duncie, when you have free time, come visit me more often. Just chatting and enjoying the view is quite wonderful.

10442737.en: Alright! Let's... take a look around the area.

10442744.en: I lost... sigh. I really wish this game could have gone on forever.

10442745.en: I was merely a lady overseeing icy souls in the past—what would I know about the secrets of heaven and earth? Let's just chat and share our thoughts, shall we?

10442746.en: They say tea is something that cleanses the mundane and washes away the dust from our hearts. Today, here amid this wonderful scenery, we can cast aside all worldly burdens and just have tea.

10442747.en: If only we could spend every day in such beautiful places, chatting and drinking tea together—how wonderful that would be!

10442749.en: I truly envy these carefree little fish.

10442750.en: The scenery here is perfect today—let's have a few drinks then.

10442751.en: Shall we come here again to share a few drinks in the future?

10442752.en: Though these flowers are beautiful, they will inevitably wither. How lamentable that all beautiful things are so fleeting, impossible for us to hold onto.

10442753.en: I... I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said such gloomy things. We should be enjoying ourselves together.

10442754.en: I always worry that my cold energy might inadvertently transfer to you during our sparring, causing you to suffer needlessly. How about this—let's just go through the motions and stop at first contact.

10442755.en: I thought I had grown accustomed to being alone and living in loneliness and solitude, but ever since I met you, I find myself always hoping you'll stay by my side...

10442756.en: As long as you say it's good, then it is good.

10442757.en: Sigh... once you take a firm stance, someone will oppose you and seek to harm you. You must be more careful from now on.

10442758.en: Mm-hmm, as long as you're willing to cultivate with me, there's nothing wrong with that...

10442760.en: Sigh... happy times are always fleeting...

10442761.en: Are you inviting me to go outside? That's good! Let's go!

10442766.en: Hmm, I don't know why, but whenever I'm waiting for you to come over, my heart always goes thump-thump and beats so hard. How strange.

10442767.en: Playing Go? I... I don't know how to play this... but I'll try playing with you!

10442768.en: Oh, these black and white pieces are fascinating! Will you bring me to play again next time?

10442769.en: Debate? I know about debates! I watched others debate before, saying the way of heaven reduces excess and supplements deficiency. Come on, let's debate!

10442770.en: Tea? That slightly bitter, smooth drink! I really love drinking it!

10442771.en: Hmm, next time, bring me to drink this beverage again, okay? Preferably... bring me the time after next too!

10442772.en: These little fish look so silly and amusing.

10442773.en: The fish may look foolish, but their peaceful life seems to surpass ours in many ways.

10442774.en: Have a drink? That doesn't seem quite proper, maybe... Well, I'll drink a little with you then, just a little bit!

10442775.en: This drink... is really good! Let's have another jar! It tastes sweet and warm, and my heart even goes thump-thump!

10442776.en: Flowers! I like looking at flowers the most!

10442777.en: Flowers bloom for only a fleeting moment; after that, they wither into fertile soil, quietly awaiting rebirth and renewed vitality in the coming year. That courage of embracing life through death earns my deep admiration!

10442778.en: I still feel like I haven't quite adapted to my current body, and sparring would be perfect for strengthening my physique! Let's have a match!

10442779.en: {name|A}, could you... could you bring me out more often? I know I often make trouble and annoy people. But when I can't see you, I really miss you so much, so very much...

10442780.en: That's right, people say you become like those you spend time with. The people in your sect are just like you - all energetic and fiery!

10442781.en: Yes! Everything you say is right! Uh... though I don't really understand what you're talking about.

10442782.en: Great! Let's cultivate together then, and I can even be your guardian!

10442783.en: As long as it's from you... I like it.

10442784.en: Ah! Are you... leaving? Alright then, time flies by so quickly.

10442785.en: You arrive at {name|B}'s home, only to find {name|B} lying on the ground, rambling incoherently...

10442786.en: {name|A}... {name|A}... I want to play with {name|A}... want to be with {name|A} every day... want to hold {gender2|A} while we nap together...

10442787.en: Though {name|B} is heavily drunk, her alertness remains sharp. She senses someone approaching and immediately casts a wary glance, but seeing it's you, that piercing gaze instantly softens. She scratches her head with a giggling smile, then moves like a phantom dancer as she flashes before you and tackles you to the ground...

10442788.en: {name|A}! I like you! Let's cultivate together!

10442789.en: {name|B} snuggles in your embrace, giggling as she leans her head closer as if about to kiss your face. Her fragrant scent mingles with the alcoholic smell on her breath, washing over you...

10442790.en: You touch the Spirit Platform and Lumbar Yang points on her back to dispel the alcohol from her. {name|B}'s eyes briefly clear before growing hazy again. She leans against you, her hands touching the Hundred Joints and Great Nexus points on your head and neck. Your chests press together as vital energy flows from your bodies, entering each other through your hands. Your Qi form complementary circulations, and soon you both enter a meditative trance without thought or desire, only a faint, ineffable sense of fulfillment seeping into every bone and sinew and circulating endlessly...

10442791.en: Huh, you're awake?... I'm sorry, I was drunk and acting foolishly... sorry, sorry... I... I... still need to assemble a component, so I... I'll head back first!

10442792.en: After you push {name|B} away, she immediately collapses to the ground and falls into a deep sleep, only occasionally mumbling incoherently in her slumber...

10442794.en: {name|B} spoke drowsily for a while, then before long fell into a deep sleep...

10442801.en: The way of Go holds infinite variations. We can use this opportunity to explore the profound mysteries of yin-yang warfare.

10442802.en: Not bad, your skills are quite good. I concede.

10442803.en: The way of Heaven and Earth is profound and subtle and is difficult to fathom. Let us discuss these mysteries and hope to glimpse a trace of the universe's secrets.

10442804.en: Tea clears the mind and cleanses the lungs. It is indeed a wonderful thing.

10442805.en: Everything happens for a reason. These leaves must develop this slightly bitter taste to ward off natural predators. It shows that survival of the fittest is everywhere. Even unconscious plants are constantly engaged in struggle and competition with all things—none can escape this universal truth.

10442806.en: Uh, actually... this tea is... very good...

10442807.en: Alright, since you want to feed the fish, let's use this opportunity to relax a bit.

10442808.en: We watch the fish for pleasure, but who knows—perhaps in some higher realm, there's also a pair of companions traveling together, chatting and playing, watching you and me for their own amusement.

10442809.en: Well... what I mean is, being together with you makes me very happy.

10442810.en: Drink helps one forget worries. Let us drink a cup and temporarily set aside the trivial matters of this world.

10442811.en: Light drinking suits the mood, while heavy drinking disturbs one's nature. This substance should be tasted lightly, then set aside. Otherwise, one would be acting like those common drunkards collapsing by the roadside and babbling nonsense—wouldn't that invite mockery?

10442812.en: Well... what I mean is, all things should be done in moderation—it's not good to go too far. Let us have a couple of drinks and fully savor today's joy. That would be quite enough.

10442813.en: The flourishing blooms before us are at their peak—this is precisely the time to admire them. Otherwise, once their season ends and they fall into the mud, they'll only be dismissed without a second glance.

10442814.en: Actually, what I was trying to say is... being able to wander this place with you today, admiring the flowers and the plants, is truly delightful...

10442816.en: Longing only causes distraction and indolence, preventing one from focusing wholeheartedly. Heaven's work in creation must have its purpose, yet living beings, already overwhelmed with their own survival and struggles, still develop longings and concerns for others—truly the height of contradiction.

10442817.en: What I mean to say is... missing you causes me distress, but once we're reunited, there's boundless joy. It's truly wondrous...

10442819.en: Good and evil, righteousness and wickedness often differ by a single thought. Yet you steadfastly guard your principles and remain constant from beginning to end—that's truly admirable.

10442820.en: Excellent! I was just thinking of learning about your martial arts.

10442822.en: Life is fleeting, and having today's joy already leaves me without regret. I only hope... Well, ahem! Today was a great day. When we have leisure time, we should gather together more often.

10442823.en: {name|B} sits idly in a corner, staring at the back of her hand in fascination. Looking closely, you can see an arachnid woven from spider silk moving left and right across her snow-white skin in a most intriguing manner.

10442824.en: Hmph, it's all because I've been too absorbed in understanding the mysteries of heaven and earth, neglecting to interact with others...

10442826.en: You're here? Sit wherever you'd like. I need to check if the spider silk binding the crystal in the earth vein has loosened.

10442829.en: Hmph, I never thought I'd still be talking to myself like a little girl in front of a woven toy. How ridiculous...

10442831.en: I wonder how women speak to men? It seems I still need to learn from them how to interact with others...

10442832.en: Sigh, I can't help but speak of worldly matters and natural philosophy in every conversation. {name|A} will probably find it terribly boring... Hm? Someone's here! He's coming! Sigh, enough of this.

10442833.en: {name|B} falls silent. With a gentle gesture of her hand, the arachnid leaps down to the ground, scurrying to a hidden spot and vanishing from sight.
